reference: Buoyancy-driven opening flow, neutral pressure level and the steady single-zone sensible heat balance implemented from CIBSE AM10 and ASHRAE Handbook - Fundamentals chapters 16 and 18, solved with scipy.optimize.brentq; cross-checked against the analytic two-opening stack formula.
citations: CIBSE Applications Manual AM10, "Natural ventilation in non-domestic buildings", 2005, section 5 (stack-driven flow, neutral pressure level, discharge coefficient)

ASHRAE Handbook - Fundamentals (2021), chapter 16 "Ventilation and Infiltration", thermal (stack) pressure difference dp = g (rho_o - rho_i) (z_NPL - z) and the orifice relation Q = Cd A sqrt(2 dp / rho)
ASHRAE Handbook - Fundamentals (2021), chapter 18 "Nonresidential Cooling and Heating Load Calculations", sol-air temperature Te = To + alpha It/ho - eps dR/ho
W.G. Brown and K.R. Solvason, "Natural convection through rectangular openings in partitions", Int. J. Heat Mass Transfer 5:859-868, 1962 (orifice/discharge coefficient convention)
